title: Bug Report: Vitess 16 online DDL makes xtrabackup to fails
body:
### Overview of the Issue

Similar to https://github.com/vitessio/vitess/issues/12300 but this time with an online DDL.

I runned:

```sql
SET @@ddl_strategy='vitess';

ALTER TABLE my_table
DROP COLUMN my_column;

alter vitess_migration '...' cleanup;

ALTER TABLE my_other_table
DROP COLUMN my_column;

alter vitess_migration '...' cleanup;
```

@reporter what is the version of xtrabackup? This is somewhat mysterious because to our knowledge this is supposed to be a problem only with MySQL 8.0.29 but you are running into it with MySQL 8.0.30.

The workaround would be the same as what you used for #12300 but it will be good to get to the root cause for this for sure.

comments.author: participant2
comments.body:
Under the hood Online DDL only runs standard MySQL primitives; it creates a table, drops a column on that table, copies data over. I don't have any immediate insight on why `xtrabackup` would fail? To MySQL, Vitess's Online DDL looks like anything a user might do.

Moreover, we're not using `INSTANT DDL`, which in my understanding does cause `xtrabackup` failures for some versions. This is isn't the case here.

comments.author: participant1
comments.body:
@reporter did you follow the upgrade instructions? From the release notes
```
However, if you are running MySQL 8.0 on the vitess-operator, with for instance vitess/lite:v15.0.2-mysql80, considering that we are bumping the patch version of MySQL 80 from 8.0.23 to 8.0.30, you will have to manually upgrade:

Add innodb_fast_shutdown=0 to your extra cnf in your YAML file.
Apply this file.
Wait for all the pods to be healthy.
Then change your YAML file to use the new Docker Images (vitess/lite:v16.0.0, defaults to mysql80).
Remove innodb_fast_shutdown=0 from your extra cnf in your YAML file.
Apply this file.
```

The log says:

```
"Feb 28, 2023 @ 18:00:17.682","I0228 17:00:17.682589       9 main.go:96] I0228 17:00:17.682011 backup.go:108] I0228 17:00:17.681940 xtrabackupengine.go:369] xtrabackup stderr: 2023-02-28T17:00:17.681854-00:00 0 [ERROR] [MY-011825] [Xtrabackup] Found tables with row versions due to INSTANT ADD/DROP columns"
```

hmmmm, is it possible thought that the `ALTER TABLE` we run on the empty vreplication (aka "shadow") table, is implicitly a `INSTANT` operation? That's a possibility. If that is indeed the case, the solution is for vitess to add `ALGORITHM=COPY`.

comments.author: participant2
comments.body: This issue shouldn't be tied to the vitess version -- it should be tied to the MySQL version, I believe. The vitess logic hasn't changed in a while on that part. But possibly a recent MySQL version chooses to implicitly use `INSTANT` algorithm where a previous MySQL version did not? Just a conjecture.

comments.author: participant2
comments.body: Possibly related: https://github.com/vitessio/vitess/pull/12436

comments.author: participant1
comments.body:
> This issue shouldn't be tied to the vitess version -- it should be tied to the MySQL version, I believe. The vitess logic hasn't changed in a while on that part. But possibly a recent MySQL version chooses to implicitly use `INSTANT` algorithm where a previous MySQL version did not? Just a conjecture.

Agreed. We do know that MySQL has been making more and more DDLs INSTANT over time, and 8.0.23 is a pretty old version at this point. It's unfortunate that INSTANT DDL doesn't seem to be compatible with xtrabackup though.

comments.author: participant2
comments.body:
> It's unfortunate that INSTANT DDL doesn't seem to be compatible with xtrabackup though.

This has some far reaching implications, in case users choose to either:

- `ApplySchema` with `direct` strategy, or
- `ApplySchema` with `mysql` strategy, or
- just run `ALTER TABLE` in `vtgate`,
- and use `ALGORITHM=INSTANT`.

We will not be able to use xtrabackup in such scenarios to backup their databases.

> From my understanding it needs MySQL >= 8.0.32

In my understanding it not only needs that version, it needs tables to have been altered _in that version_. So a table altered in a `8.0.31` is never going to work, even if later the server is upgraded to `8.0.32`.

- Switch your backups to use the builtin method instead of xtrabackup and take an immediate backup
- this requires you to change some flags/properties in your deployment yaml and re-deploy. vtctld and vttablets will all need to be rolled with the new flags.
